name: CCA 102 鸟击 左1风挡裂开

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air China 102, now call Wuhan Approach and report you are 10 miles north of Hekou, you are continuing approaching.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 Air China 102，现在呼叫 武汉进近，报告你在 Hekou 以北 10 miles，继续进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CCA102, we are 10 miles north of Hekou.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CCA102，我们在 Hekou 以北 10 miles。

cards.audioText:
C: Air China 102, Wuhan Approach is with you. Have you got the current ATIS?
B: You give an affirmative reply and report that you have received information Lima.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 102，武汉进近 收到。你们收到当前 ATIS 了吗？
B: 你肯定回答并报告已收到信息 Lima。

cards.audioText: B: Suddenly you find a sharp drop in RPM, report you have a trouble with starboard engine.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 突然你发现 RPM 急剧下降，报告右发有故障。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CCA102, we have a trouble with right engine, RPM has dropped rapidly.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CCA102，我们右发有故障，RPM 快速下降。

cards.audioText:
C: Air China 102, what is your intention?
B: Tell the controller you intend to land with radar vector.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 102，你的意图是什么？
B: 告诉管制员你打算接受雷达引导落地。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CCA102, we would like radar vector to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CCA102，我们希望雷达引导到武汉机场落地。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 102, continue on your present heading, radar will vector you to ILS approach.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 102，保持当前航向，雷达将引导你做 ILS 进近。
cards.referenceText: Continue present heading, radar vector to ILS approach, CCA102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持当前航向，雷达引导 ILS 进近，CCA102。

cards.audioText: B: Ask if you could get any airport assistance there, your engine needs maintenance.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 询问那里是否有机场协助，你们的发动机需要维修。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CCA102, could I get any airport assistance there? Our engine needs some maintenance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CCA102，那里能提供机场协助吗？我们的发动机需要维修。

cards.audioText:
C: Affirm. Maintenance is available at this airport. I will continue to give you instructions and give you all the important information. Are you able to maintain 4200 meters?
B: Tell the controller you could.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 肯定。本机场有维修。我会继续给你指令并提供所有重要信息。你能保持 4200 meters 吗？
B: 告诉管制员可以。
cards.referenceText: Affirm, we can maintain 4200 meters, CCA102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 肯定，我们可以保持 4200 meters，CCA102。

cards.audioText: B: 15 minutes later, you have established localizer, report to the controller.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 15 分钟后，你已建立航向道，向管制员报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CCA102, established on localizer.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CCA102，已建立航向道。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 102, descend to 900 meters on QNH 1012, cleared ILS approach runway 18R.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 102，按 QNH 1012 下降到 900 meters，许可 ILS 进近跑道 18 right。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 900 meters on QNH1012, ILS approach runway 18 right, CCA102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按 QNH1012 下降到 900 meters，ILS 进近跑道 18 right，CCA102。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 102, contact Wuhan Tower 124.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 102，联系武汉塔台124.35。

cards.audioText: B: Contact Tower and report you had bird strike.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 联系塔台并报告你们遭遇鸟击。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA102, we had bird strike.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA102，我们遭遇鸟击。

cards.audioText:
C: Air China 102, report your intention.
B: You request to reduce speed to minimum approach speed. You also report that No.1 left windshield is cracked. The inner glass pane become broken.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: Air China 102，报告你的意图。
B: 你请求减速到最小进近速度。你还报告 1 号左风挡有裂纹，内层玻璃破裂。
cards.referenceText: We would like to reduce speed to minimum approach speed. No.1 left windshield is cracked. The inner glass pane become broken, CCA102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们希望减速到最小进近速度。1 号左风挡有裂纹，内层玻璃破裂，CCA102。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 102, reduce to minimum approach speed. Report runway in sight.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 102，减到最小进近速度。看到跑道报告。
cards.referenceText: Reduce to minimum approach speed, wilco, CCA102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 减到最小进近速度，照办，CCA102。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 102, visibility is 8 miles, wind 270 at 10 knots, QNH 1013, landing runway 18R.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 102，能见度 8 miles，风 270 度 10 knots，QNH 1013，落地跑道 18 right。

cards.audioText: B: You have runway in sight, report it to Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你已看到跑道，向塔台报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA102, runway in sight.
